我國青海、江西等地，掌控了多處優質鋰礦資      Province in China, enables us to operate several high-quality lithium
源，形成了穩定、優質、多元化的原材料供       resources, which give us a stable, high-quality, diverse resource supply
應體系。大部分礦產資源簽訂了長期採購協       chain system. The Company has entered into long-term procurement
議。公司現用的主要鋰資源為澳大利亞Mount    agreements with regard to a majority of such lithium resources. Lithium

鋰化合物：贛鋒生態系統的核心為鋰化合物業      Lithium compounds: At the core of Ganfeng Ecosystem is the lithium
務板塊，主要包括(1)電池級碳酸鋰；(2)電池   compounds business segment, mainly including (1) battery grade lithium
級氫氧化鋰；(3)氯化鋰；(4)氟化鋰。用於電   carbonate; (2) battery-grade lithium hydroxide; (3) lithium chloride; and
動汽車、便攜式電子設備等鋰電池材料及化學      (4) lithium fluoride. Such lithium compounds are used as lithium battery
及製藥領域，客戶主要包括電池正極材料製造      materials for electric vehicles, portable electronics, as well as in chemical
商。                        and pharmaceutical fields. Our customers primarily consist of battery
                          cathode materials manufacturers.

金屬鋰：公司的金屬鋰產品產能排名全球第       Lithium metals: The lithium metals production capacity of the Company
一。公司能夠生產若干不同大小及厚度的金屬      ranks No. 1 globally. The Company is capable of producing a number of

主要用於(1)鋰電池負極材料；(2)醫藥反應催   thickness, as well as lithium alloys in the form of powder and foil, which are
化劑；(3)合金及其他用於工業品材料，客戶     mainly used (1) as lithium battery anode materials; (2) as pharmaceutical
包括電池製造商及醫藥企業。金屬鋰原料主要      catalysts; and (3) in alloys and other industrial product materials. Our
來自鋰化合物業務板塊及鋰電池回收業務板       customers consist of battery manufacturers and pharmaceutical companies.
塊、及從醫藥企業回收的催化劑溶液中回收的      Raw materials of our lithium metals are mainly from our lithium compounds
氯化鋰。                      and lithium battery recycling business segments as well as lithium

腦等。並積極推進固態鋰電池的研發和商業化      storage equipment and all kinds of consumer electronic devices, such
生產，固態鋰電池將大幅提高現有鋰電池的安      as mobile phones, tablets and laptops. Meanwhile, the Company also
全性及能量密度，創造電池更安全、更精細、      proactively carries forward the research, development and commercial
儲能更高的新時代。                 production of solid-state lithium batteries. The solid-state lithium batteries

     1.    鋰行業市場變化風險                                  1.   Risks concerning market changes in the lithium industry

           公司受到鋰行業的市場變化影響，包括                               The Company is under the influence of market changes in the
           目前及預期鋰的可用資源、鋰行業的競                               lithium industry, including the current and expected lithium resource
           爭格局、鋰產品終端市場需求、科技發                               available, the competitive landscape of the lithium industry, demand
           展、政府政策以及全球及地區經濟狀況                               in end markets for lithium products, technological developments,
           等，鋰需求取決於終端市場鋰的使用情                               government policies as well as global and regional economic
           況以及整體經濟狀況。近年來，鋰需求                               conditions. The demand for lithium is dependent on the use of lithium
           增加主要由電動汽車電池及儲能電池的                               in end markets, and the general economic conditions. The increase
           需求迅速增長所推動，中國政府大力發                               in demand for lithium in recent years has been primarily driven by the
           展新能源汽車產業，推出優惠政策鼓勵                               explosive growth in demand for electric vehicle batteries and energy
           購買電動汽車。                                         storage batteries. Besides, the Chinese government has also been
                                                           pushing for the development of the new-energy vehicle industry
                                                           and has introduced generous incentives to encourage purchases of
                                                           electric vehicles.

           目前，新能源汽車銷量對政府補貼、充                               The sales of new energy vehicles is heavily reliant on the government
           電網路建設、汽車上牌政策等依賴較                                subsidies, charging network construction, vehicle registration policy
           大，如果未來國家相關政策進行大幅調                               and so forth at present. Any substantial adjustment to such state
           整或政策不能得到有效落實，將會對公                               policies or any failure in effective implementation of such policies in
           司所處的鋰行業產生不利影響。                                  the future will impose adverse impacts on the lithium industry which
                                                           the Company pertains to.

           公司相關措施：公司會積極運用我們的                               The Company’s mitigation: the Company will make full use of
           技術優勢與產品質量優勢，認清市場的                               our technological edges and advantage product quality, have a

利潤分配政策                        PROFITS DISTRIBUTION POLICIES

根據本公司之公司章程，公司的利潤分配政策          According to the Articles of Association of the Company, the profits
如下：                           distribution policies of the Company are as follows:

•   利潤分配原則：公司實施積極的利潤分         •    Profit distribution principle: The company implements a positive
    配政策，重視對投資者的合理投資回               profit distribution policy, pays attention to the reasonable return on
    報，並保持連續性和穩定性，同時兼顧              investment of investors, and maintains continuity and stability while
    公司的可持續發展。利潤分配不得超過              taking into account the sustainable development of the Company.

             公允價值計量                                                       Fair value measurement

             本集團在各報告期末，以公允價值計量                                            The Group measures its investment properties, derivative financial
             其投資物業、衍生金融工具及股權投                                             instruments and equity investments at fair value at the end of each
             資。公允價值是指在計量日，市場參與                                            reporting period. Fair value is the price that would be received to
             者在正常交易活動中銷售資產收到或者                                            sell an asset or paid to transfer a liability in an orderly transaction
             清償債務所支付的金額。公允價值計量                                            between market participants at the measurement date. The fair value
             基於假設銷售資產或清償債務的交易發                                            measurement is based on the presumption that the transaction to
             生於該資產或債務的主要市場，或者在                                            sell the asset or transfer the liability takes place either in the principal
             缺失主要市場的情況下，發生於在最有                                            market for the asset or liability, or in the absence of a principal
             利於該資產或負債的市場。主要市場或                                            market, in the most advantageous market for the asset or liability. The
             者最優市場必須是本集團可以參與的市                                            principal or the most advantageous market must be accessible by
             場。一項資產或負債的公允價值計量基                                            the Group. The fair value of an asset or a liability is measured using
             於一項假設，即當市場參與者進行資產                                            the assumptions that market participants would use when pricing
             或負債定價時會考慮使他們的經濟利益                                            the asset or liability, assuming that market participants act in their
             最大化。                                                         economic best interest.

             非金融資產公允價值的計量需考慮市場                                            A fair value measurement of a non-financial asset takes into account
             參與者在最優化使用該資產或者將其銷                                            a market participant’s ability to generate economic benefits by using
             售給另一個能夠最優化使用該資產的市                                            the asset in its highest and best use or by selling it to another market
             場參與者的情況下產生經濟利益的能                                             participant that would use the asset in its highest and best use.
             力。

             本集團在不同的情形下使用適當的估值                                            The Group uses valuation techniques that are appropriate in the
             技術，為準確計量公允價值需獲取充                                             circumstances and for which sufficient data are available to measure
             足的數據，最大化使用相關可觀測輸入                                            fair value, maximising the use of relevant observable inputs and
             值，最小化使用不可觀察輸入值。                                              minimising the use of unobservable inputs.

  金融資產減值                   Impairment of financial assets

  本集團確認對並非按公允價值計入損益        The Group recognises an allowance for ECLs for all debt instruments
  的所有債務工具預期信貸虧損的撥備。        not held at fair value through profit or loss. ECLs are based on the
  預期信貸虧損乃基於根據合約到期的合        difference between the contractual cash flows due in accordance with
  約現金流量與本集團預期收取的所有現        the contract and all the cash flows that the Group expects to receive,
  金流量之間的差額而釐定，並以原實際        discounted at an approximation of the original effective interest rate.
  利率的近似值貼現。預期現金流量將包        The expected cash flows will include cash flows from the sale of
  括出售所持抵押的現金流量或組成合約        collateral held or other credit enhancements that are integral to the
  條款的其他信貸提升措施。             contractual terms.

  一般方法                    General approach

   預期信貸虧損分兩個階段進行確認。就       ECLs are recognised in two stages. For credit exposures for
   自初始確認起未有顯著增加的信貸風險       which there has not been a significant increase in credit risk since
   而言，預期信貸虧損提供予由未來十二       initial recognition, ECLs are provided for credit losses that result
   個月內可能發生違約事件而導致的信貸       from default events that are possible within the next 12 months (a
   虧損（十二個月預期信貸虧損）。就自初      12-month ECL). For those credit exposures for which there has been
   始確認起經已顯著增加的信貸風險而        a significant increase in credit risk since initial recognition, a loss
   言，不論何時發生違約，於餘下風險年       allowance is required for credit losses expected over the remaining
   期內的預期信貸虧損均須計提虧損撥備       life of the exposure, irrespective of the timing of the default (a lifetime
  （年限內預期信貸虧損）。             ECL).

  基於逾期日數，以將具有類似損失模式               rates are based on days past due for groupings of various customer
